ns2:section.sectionText: Not intended for students in the Natural Res & Env Sci department. This is an online course taught on Compass with no classroom sessions. However, you must be present for three evening exams that occur on campus. Course is limited to first 500 students who enroll (no waiting list, no course overrides, no exceptions). Further information at: http://go.illinois.edu/NRES102.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for Natural Resrcs & Environ Sci major(s).
